description: This file implements the main application delegate and app struct for an iOS app using SwiftUI. It manages push notification registration, background tasks, scene phase changes, and handling of custom watch prompt notifications. It also defines functions for scheduling and processing notifications, as well as integrating with app-specific models to handle actions triggered from notifications and watch prompts.

classes.name: OpenClawAppDelegate
classes.description: Main application delegate managing app lifecycle, notifications, background refresh, and scene phase.

methods.name: application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)
methods.description: Initializes background task registration, notification delegate, and remote notifications registration upon app launch.

methods.name: application(_:didRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithDeviceToken:)
methods.description: Handles successful registration for remote notifications, passing device token to the app model.

methods.name: application(_:didFailToRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithError:)
methods.description: Logs failure to register for remote notifications.

methods.name: application(_:didReceiveRemoteNotification:fetchCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles incoming silent push notifications, attempts to wake app model, schedules background refresh if needed.

methods.name: scenePhaseChanged(_:)
methods.description: Schedules background wake refresh when the scene enters background.

methods.name: registerBackgroundWakeRefreshTask()
methods.description: Registers background refresh task with the system.

methods.name: scheduleBackgroundWakeRefresh(afterSeconds:reason:)
methods.description: Schedules background wake refresh with a delay and reason.

methods.name: handleBackgroundWakeRefresh(task:)
methods.description: Handles background wake logic, including rescheduling and invoking app model wake handler.

methods.name: isWatchPromptNotification(_:)
methods.description: Determines if a notification info corresponds to a watch prompt notification.

methods.name: parseWatchPromptAction(from:)
methods.description: Parses watch prompt actions from notification responses and returns a pending action if valid.

methods.name: routeWatchPromptAction(_:)
methods.description: Routes the watch prompt action to the app model, or queues it if the model isn't ready.

methods.name: userNotificationCenter(_:willPresent:withCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles notification presentation options when a notification is about to be presented.

methods.name: userNotificationCenter(_:didReceive:withCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles user interaction with notifications, including watch prompt actions.
